next.name: Cyndaquil
next.summary: Card-by-card scan review, a tour of the app, and swaps, a feed and a weekly challenge

highlights.title: Review scans one card at a time
highlights.text: Add a card and go straight to the next, with no limit on how many photos you take.

highlights.title: A tour of the app
highlights.text: A hands-on tour shows new trainers around. Replay it any time from Settings › About.

highlights.title: Swaps, a feed and a weekly challenge
highlights.text: Swap with friends, cheer their pulls and chase one goal a week, once your server turns them on.

new: Review all: go through your scans one card at a time. Add to collection moves straight to the next card.
Scan as many cards as you like in one go. The 50-photo limit is gone.
If none of the matches is right, tap None of these and search for the card yourself.
Tap your photo or the matched card in the review to see it full screen.
A hands-on tour for new trainers, and a Take the tour card on Home for everyone else.
What's new: after an update, a short summary of what changed. The full version history is in Settings › About.
Swap offers: offer some of your cards for some of a friend's spare cards, from the Trades page.
An Offers tab on Trades shows the offers waiting for you, with a number on the Trades tile on your Profile and a card on Home.
A fair-trade meter shows how even a swap is before you send it or answer it.
Accept, counter or decline an offer, or cancel one you sent. Add a short note to an offer.
Nothing moves until you both tap Swapped after you meet. Finished swaps appear in your trade history.
Notifications for swap offers name the cards (never amounts), including when an offer is declined.
An activity feed shows your friends' new sets, big pulls, badges and goals. React with Cheer, Wow, Fire or Love it, and add a short comment.
Your own shared moments appear in the feed too, marked You, with how many reactions they got.
A weekly challenge sets one goal for every trainer each week (Monday to Sunday, UK time). Everyone who finishes earns a badge, and the highest counts by Sunday night make the podium.
The challenge shows on Home under your daily quests and as a Challenge tab on the leaderboard.
Swaps, the feed and the weekly challenge appear once the person who runs your server turns them on.
better: When the scanner is switched off, your scans say Waiting for the scanner and are recognised as soon as it is back.
The leaderboard opens at the top, with its tabs in view.

underTheHood: Swaps, the feed and the challenge have an on/off switch for the whole server.
A problem with one trainer's account no longer holds up background updates for everyone else.

releases.name: Chikorita
releases.summary: Chase goals, a weekly recap and goals at a glance

highlights.title: Chase goals
highlights.text: Pick a set, a generation, an evolution family or an artist, and watch the ring fill as you collect.

highlights.title: Your weekly recap
highlights.text: On Sunday evening Home shows how your week went.

highlights.title: Goals at a glance
highlights.text: A Goals tile on your Profile, and your goals next to your sets on Home.

new: Goals, with a Goals tile on your Profile.
Family goals count every card in an evolution family.
A weekly recap card on Home from Sunday evening.
better: Your goals show on Home next to your sets.

underTheHood: Your weekly numbers are now kept so they can be looked back on.

releases.name: Squirtle
releases.summary: The daily loop, badges and binder pockets

highlights.title: A reason to open the app every day
highlights.text: The Today card shows your Pokémon of the day, your streak, daily quests, XP and your trainer level, plus a game of Who's That Pokémon.

highlights.title: Badges to earn
highlights.text: Unlock gym-style badges as your collection grows, with a moment of celebration each time.

highlights.title: Binders that match the real thing
highlights.text: Drag cards into pockets just like a physical binder, and flip through sets and binders in Book view.

new: The Today card, with a streak you can protect with a freeze.
Daily quests, XP and a trainer level.
Who's That Pokémon.
Achievements and gym-badge tracks.
Book view for sets and binders.
Binder pockets with drag and drop (press and hold to pick a card up).
Holo cards shine and tilt with your phone, with their own foil patterns.
Notifications by category and a number on the app icon.
Detailed notifications that name the cards, prices and badges.
On this day.
Showcase 6 on the leaderboard, and each trainer's streak.
Collection DNA.
Share your daily progress as a picture.
better: Tap the most expensive print on the Today card to open it.
Prints on offer match your sync languages.
Foil is smoother on iPhone and matches in the zoom.
fixed: Restoring an older backup into a newer app works.
Background restore, CSV pocket sizes and the "scans ready" notification are fixed.

underTheHood: Your history (cards, streaks, quests) is recorded from now on.
Badge and notification checks run every 30 seconds.

releases.name: Charmander
releases.summary: The iPhone redesign and your whole card list offline

highlights.title: A new look made for iPhone
highlights.text: A tab bar at the bottom, big titles and sheets that slide up like the apps you already know.

highlights.title: Scan starts with the camera
highlights.text: Open Scan and you're ready to take the photo.

highlights.title: Your whole card list offline
highlights.text: Download the card database and pictures, and Search and Sets work without a signal.

new: A new Home, Collection, Search, Sets, Pokédex, Analytics and Settings.
A launch screen with your Pokémon of the day (you can skip it).
Pull down to refresh on any page.
Browse Sets by language, then series.
Search finds cards by name, set and number in any order and corrects typos.
A Scan inbox to review what you've scanned.
Download the card database and card pictures for offline use.
Choose which languages to sync and see the progress.
better: The app launches faster when pictures are saved on your phone.
Offline settings are clearer, with a true storage breakdown.
fixed: Settings no longer crashes on the Account page.
Pull to refresh no longer spins forever.
Japanese sets show their own cards.
Back from a large set no longer freezes.
Series logos stay after a sync.

underTheHood: Scanner settings can be set for the whole server.

releases.name: Bulbasaur
releases.summary: PokéCollector on your Home Screen, and offline

highlights.title: Add it to your Home Screen
highlights.text: PokéCollector now opens full screen like any other app.

highlights.title: Works without a signal
highlights.text: Browse your collection even when you're offline, and scan cards anywhere: the photo waits on your phone and is sent when you're back.

highlights.title: Price alerts on your phone
highlights.text: Get a notification when a card on your wishlist changes price.

new: Add PokéCollector to your Home Screen.
A Sync & offline page shows what's saved and what is waiting to send.
An offline banner tells you when you have no connection.
Pages you've opened before work offline.
Scan photos taken offline are kept and uploaded later.
Price alerts arrive as notifications on your phone.
You stay signed in while offline.
Settings and exchange rates are kept for offline use.
When a new version is ready, a bar at the top lets you update, with an "Updating…" screen while it installs.
better: Offline features are on for everyone.
If a large card picture isn't saved, the small one shows instead.
fixed: The app no longer hangs at start-up when your connection is poor.
The offline banner now sits below the iPhone's status bar and shows up reliably.

underTheHood: A service worker keeps the app and your data on the phone.
Updates wait for you to tap Update.
Offline scans are queued in a local outbox.
